decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 15th October 2013, the proposal as shown on the drawing submitted on 22nd October 2013 and numbered 1 Location plan, OCT/13/05 and as verified on site was not lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development fails to comply with the terms of Schedule 2, Part 1 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (as amended in 2008) because there is currently an enforcement notice in effect against the outbuilding, therefore it cannot be seen to be lawful (REFER TO: S.191 (2) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, it states that uses and operations are lawful at any time is (a) no enforcement action may then be taken ion respect of them and (b) they do not constitute a contravention of any of the requirements of any enforcement notice in force).
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the existing single storey deatched outbuilding to the rear
